title: Mondelez's Multi-Million Portfolio Shift: Unloads French Bakery and Cereal Bars Business
summary: Mondelez International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) on Tuesday announced it would sell its French bread substitutes and cereal bars businesses to Princes Group PLC (OTC:PRNSY), an international platform in the U.K. and European food and beverage sector. The transaction involves four established French brands – Heudebert, Pelletier, Cracotte and Grany and three manufacturing facilities located in Granville, Vervins and Toulouse.
